Definition: from G2413; a priest (literally or figuratively):--(high) priest.
BiblicalUsage: hiereús — (high) priest. That is the whole of it, and it is enough: 31 occurrences, and in Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John the meaning never wavers. I keep coming back to the simple reading because the simple reading is the true one.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe hiereús matters because God chose the priest; the priest never chose himself. I hold that the simple reading is the true one, and I will not trade it for a clever one.
RelatedEvents: Jesus Heals a Man with Leprosy; The Birth of John the Baptist
